args.body: Take SHOPIFY-SAMPLE-DATA-LOSS-REPAIR. The operator audit is reproducible quality feedback, not buyer demand or a release approval. Verify its findings, repair the existing sample and demonstrate that split outputs preserve every product and failed checks fail the process. Preserve current live experiments and their deadlines. Stop after the bounded repair; do not expand Shopify inventory or publish it.

description: The operator audit reproduced silent output loss and a test runner that reports success on failure in the unpublished Shopify sample. Correct these concrete delivery defects before considering release. Commercial feedback has no classified events and three unclassified sources; demand remains unknown. Verified available funds and revenue remain zero. Payment collection blocks paid acceptance, but does not block this repair or the existing live observation windows.
